EnvIDE, a code editor written in EnvoL, for Linux and Windows. Run it with a folder, and a file to open: `envide <folder> [file]`.

New in 0.3.0:

- **Menu bar:** File, Edit, View, Go and Help, with every shortcut shown. F10, or Alt with a menu's first letter, opens them from the keyboard.
- **Tabs:** many files open at once, each with its own cursor and undo history. Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab move between them.
- **Saving:** New, Open File, Open Folder, Save, Save As, Save All, Revert and Close. A tab with unsaved changes has a dot, and so does the window's title. EnvIDE asks before closing a changed file or quitting, and before Save As replaces another file.
- **Backups:** unsaved changes are copied every few seconds and when the window closes. The next start in the same folder brings them back.
- **Finding things:** Go to File (Ctrl+P), Go to Line (Ctrl+G), Find (Ctrl+F, then F3) and Replace (Ctrl+H). The command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P) lists every command.
- **Icons:** by file kind in the sidebar and in Go to File, with the EnvoL mark for `.envol`, `.envon` and `.eir`.
- **View:** hide the sidebar (Ctrl+B), zoom (Ctrl+= and Ctrl+-), light or dark theme, toggle comment (Ctrl+/). Copy and paste use the system clipboard.
- **Files it should not open:** images, executables and other binary files are described instead, and files over 64 MB are refused. Text in an older encoding opens, and EnvIDE asks before saving it as UTF-8.

Not yet: completion, panels and split editors, a terminal, build and debug, plugins. See the [roadmap](https://github.com/envoscale/EnvoScale/blob/main/envide/roadmap.md).

Built with EnvoLang at the commit in `envolang.ref`. Apache-2.0.
